story_type: fishing boat aground in breaking surf, swimmer on the bow, basket hoists to the beach
hook: Seven fishermen stuck on a boat in the breaking surf.
narration: Seven fishermen were stuck on this boat, aground in the breaking surf.
The seventy six foot Carolina Queen Three had run aground near New York.
The waves were too big for the crew to swim the fishermen to the beach.
So the helicopter crew radioed a new plan. Put the rescue swimmer on the bow.
The swimmer would help each man into the rescue basket, one at a time, while the helicopter held its hover overhead.
Then the basket carried each load across the surf to the sand.
outcome: The Air Station Atlantic City crew hoisted all seven fishermen off the Carolina Queen Three and set them ashore.
title: Fishing boat aground in breaking surf
description:
On Feb. 25, 2016, a Coast Guard helicopter crew from Air Station Atlantic City hoisted seven fishermen off the 76-foot fishing vessel Carolina Queen III, aground in the surf near New York, and carried them ashore.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Air Station Atlantic City, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/451712/coast-guard-rescues-7-near-nyc
